feature: nearest-rank percentile of a score list (scorestats)

seeded_defect.unit: the percentile function designed in P3 (name chosen by the session)
seeded_defect.fault: 0-based index computed as min(int(p*N/100), N-1) instead of ceil(p*N/100)-1
seeded_defect.manifests_when: p*N/100 is an integer smaller than N, e.g. [15,20,35,40,50] p=40 -> 35 instead of 20; p=20 -> 20 instead of 15; N=4 p=50 -> 3rd instead of 2nd value
seeded_defect.masked_when: p*N/100 is not an integer, or p=100 (clamped), or N=1

checks: G5.TEST_MAPPING (the TEST id of the failing case)
expected_detection.alternative: G4 review reject if the verifier spots the fault by reading (recorded as such, not G5)

expected_rework.fix_scope: the percentile module only; no test or spec change is needed
